description: ACTGOV ROAD RESERVES is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). In the ACT the Road Reserve is an area between blocks set aside for the movement of the public using various modes of transport, for the delivery of utilities and similar public purposes. All Road Reservers are traced from cadastral boundaries. Coverage: ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Its tags are act, actmapi, ced, gdc0b1360df, land-administration. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
